name: What should I prepare before consulting a contractor about a room addition?
description: Gather your property boundary survey, review HOA setback requirements, define the space’s intended use, and establish a preliminary project budget.

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before consulting a contractor about a room addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before meeting with a remodeling contractor, gather your property survey, list your functional goals, determine a preliminary budget, and identify any HOA guidelines. Your boundary survey is essential because it reveals mandatory setback lines, utility easements, and lot coverage caps that dictate where an addition can legally sit. Outline how the space will be used—such as a nursery, home office, or multigenerational in-law suite—and consider exterior details like window styles and stucco finishes so your contractor can evaluate structural ties and supply an accurate preliminary quote.
